item.title: Some Iranians fear the regime is now more entrenched - and ready for revenge
item.description: Ordinary Iranians tell of worry about increased repression by authorities after the war is over.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
item.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

item.title: Bowen: Strait of Hormuz standoff raises risk of sliding back into all-out war
item.description: The US and Iran's determination to keep the pressure on each other has put the fragile Gulf ceasefire in serious jeopardy.

item.title: Trump calls Iran response to US proposal to end war 'totally unacceptable'
item.description: Iran is reported to want lifting of the US naval blockade, recognition of Iranian sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz and compensation for war damage.

item.title: Iran accuses US of 'reckless military adventure'
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the US attacks each time there is a diplomatic solution on the table.

item.title: His father had just been buried. Then West Bank settlers forced him to dig up the body
item.description: The UN human rights office condemns incident as "'appalling and emblematic of the dehumanisation of Palestinians" in the West Bank.

item.title: EU agrees sanctions on Israeli settlers over West Bank violence
item.description: The EU's foreign policy chief said "extremism and violence carry consequences", while Israel branded the move "arbitrary".

item.title: Israel deports two activists detained on board Gaza flotilla
item.description: Spanish national Saif Abu Keshek and Brazilian Thiago Ávila were detained by Israel after sailing in a Gaza-bound aid flotilla.

item.title: 'If we sleep, they bite': Rats and weasels infest camps for displaced Gazans
item.description: In the Gaza Strip, the daily battles are now with rats, weasels, and other pests spreading diseases.
